question: Does this revision show smooth continuously moving left-right-left turns and slow final pan, photoreal surfaces and no BAY labels or colored wayfinding?

requests.purpose: Whole-clip half-second review including every turn and final pan

claims.text: Half-second overview shows the requested left-right-left route, continuous translation during corner rotation and slower final look-around. Dense 24 fps samples at 5.5-6, 11-11.5 and 17-17.5 show incremental motion without a snap or cut. Visible wall panels are plain neutral gray, with no BAY signage or colored wayfinding in the reviewed frames; the 4.5-second panel was also examined at 1280x720. Metal server detail and practical lighting replace the blocking materials.
claims.limitation: 96 frame records reviewed, including overlaps, not every frame. Photographic appearance is subjective and the scene remains synthetic. Exact metric geometry and audio are unverified; output is 713 frames versus 720 reference frames.

warning: Viewed is a caller attestation; sampled intervals are not continuous observed coverage. No token savings or accuracy claim is measured.
